title: Voronoi nearest-point interaction
intent: Partition automobile weight and fuel-economy observations into nearest-point regions and reveal the closest car.

source.title: Observable Plot Voronoi and pointer interactions

ai.create: Create a cylinder-colored Voronoi scatterplot from raw automobile weight and fuel economy using the native optional Voronoi mark and native two-dimensional nearest-car tooltips.
ai.maintain: Change the selected cars while retaining bounded structured cells, stable source identity, dot-owned nearest focus, matching color domains, typed tooltip rows, responsive clipping, and keyboard focus.
